briefdescription.para: Callees with dynamic denormal modes are compatible with any caller mode.
Compute the logical AND of the attributes of the caller and the callee.

detaileddescription.para: This function sets the caller's attribute to false if the callee's attribute is false.

briefdescription.para: Compute the logical OR of the attributes of the caller and the callee.

detaileddescription.para: This function sets the caller's attribute to true if the callee's attribute is true.

briefdescription.para: If the inlined function had a higher stack protection level than the calling function, then bump up the caller's stack protection level.
If the inlined function required stack probes, then ensure that the calling function has those too.
If the inlined function defines the size of guard region on the stack, then ensure that the calling function defines a guard region that is no larger.
If the inlined function defines a min legal vector width, then ensure the calling function has the same or larger min legal vector width.

detaileddescription.para: If the caller has the attribute, but the callee doesn't, we need to remove the attribute from the caller since we can't make any guarantees about the caller's requirements. This function is called after the inlining decision has been made so we have to merge the attribute this way. Heuristics that would use min-legal-vector-width to determine inline compatibility would need to be handled as part of inline cost analysis.

briefdescription.para: If the inlined function has null_pointer_is_valid attribute, set this attribute in the caller post inlining.
